evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 starts rising from the ~5 ppm purged baseline (7.5 ppm)
O2 has climbed steadily to 39.1 ppm during growth, about 8x baseline, which points to oxygen getting into the tube
Ar MFC reading is steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the rise is not a drop in reported flow
T is stable at 750 °C with normal heater power, so temperature control is fine

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so I can't tell a seal leak (normal or low pressure) from an exhaust blockage (high pressure, back-diffusion). A leak check, or a short Ar flow step while watching how O2 responds, would tell them apart. The sample has not been characterized yet.
